findings: Official E2B/E4B thinking mode places the thinking control token at the beginning of the first system turn; no change to source or translation instructions is needed.
The pinned Ollama gemma4 renderer accepts boolean thinking, defaults false, and inserts the same native token when true. The imported manifest already selects the thinking-capable gemma4 parser.
The parser separates the thought channel and final content. For structured responses the runtime converts the JSON schema to grammar and applies it after the thinking close marker.

The unchanged num_predict2048 is forwarded as a single native n_predict limit. Thinking, channel markers and final output consume that one generated-token allowance; there is no separate extra final-answer allowance.

The thinking grammar can end before its closing marker. Therefore reasoning-only, empty-final, invalid-JSON or length-limited responses must remain failures; no forced close, retry or larger budget is proposed.

A deliberation stage is a plausible hypothesis for relationships and negation. Official mechanism documentation does not establish improvement in these Greek translations, material vocabulary or all longer passages.
